description: Machine-readable specialist skill registry and routing matrix for Universal Engineering Workflow

skills.purpose: Adversarial Socratic interview primitive challenging design decisions until every branch of the design tree is resolved.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply Socratic interview questions directly in execution plan before writing code.
skills.executionEvidence: Documented question-and-answer exchange clarifying requirements with resolved decision branches.

skills.purpose: Socratic interview that stress-tests architecture against official docs, establishing ubiquitous language in GLOSSARY.md and recording ADRs.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Use model-invocable 'grilling' primitive and record decisions directly in .agents/adr/.
skills.executionEvidence: Updated GLOSSARY.md and documented ADR file citing official documentation.

skills.purpose: Formulate ubiquitous language, model core business entities, and challenge domain jargon against GLOSSARY.md and ADRs.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Inspect schema files and document entity definitions and terms inline.
skills.executionEvidence: Committed or referenced domain glossary/model file defining entities and invariants.

skills.purpose: Design deep modules with small interfaces hiding implementation complexity behind clean, testable seams.
triggerConditions: Refactoring high fan-out classes or services
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply Ousterhout deep-module principles: small interface, extensive functionality, clean seam.
skills.executionEvidence: Clear interface contract file separated from concrete implementation with documented seams.

skills.purpose: Test-driven development enforcing a strict red-green-refactor loop: write failing test first, verify failure, implement, verify pass.
triggerConditions: Implementing new functionality in testable codebases
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply built-in test discipline: create failing test, run test command, confirm failure code, implement, confirm pass.
skills.executionEvidence: Terminal test output showing failing test execution (RED) followed by passing test execution (GREEN).

skills.purpose: Superpowers TDD methodology enforcing red-green cycles and behavioral specifications.
triggerConditions: Test-driven implementation in projects utilizing Superpowers
skills.executionEvidence: Terminal test output showing red-green progression.

skills.purpose: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs: build red loop -> minimise -> hypothesise -> instrument -> fix -> regression test.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply systematic debugging: reproduce before mutation, isolate minimal case, verify fix.
skills.executionEvidence: Reproduction test case or terminal trace proving defect existence prior to source code edits.

skills.purpose: Superpowers systematic debugging loop isolating root causes through hypothesis testing.
triggerConditions: Bug fixing tasks in Superpowers environments
skills.executionEvidence: Reproduction script or test confirming bug before fix.

skills.purpose: Pragmatic minimalism via the 7-Rung Decision Ladder: YAGNI -> reuse -> stdlib -> platform -> dependency -> one line -> minimum code.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply the 7-Rung Decision Ladder directly without claiming external skill invocation: eliminate speculative code, prefer standard library, write smallest diff.
skills.executionEvidence: Minimal coherent git diff with zero speculative abstractions or unused imports.

skills.purpose: Two-axis review of diff since fixed point: Standards compliance and Spec compliance.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Apply built-in references/review.md two-axis review checklist.
skills.executionEvidence: Structured review report citing exact file:line references and severity classifications.

skills.purpose: Browser runtime testing, DOM accessibility tree inspection, screenshot capture, and console error monitoring via Chrome DevTools MCP.
triggerConditions: Verifying rendered UI layouts or responsive behavior in browser-accessible apps
skills.installCommand: claude mcp add chrome-devtools npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest -- --headless=true
skills.fallbackPolicy: Mark runtime tests as NOT TESTED and rely on static component and CSS inspection.
skills.executionEvidence: Captured browser screenshot paths, console log excerpts, or DOM evaluation outputs.

skills.purpose: Real-time documentation provider querying official up-to-date framework and library documentation to prevent API hallucination.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Inspect local node_modules type definitions, inline docs, and package README files.
skills.executionEvidence: Cited documentation references, type definitions, or verified API signatures.

skills.purpose: Design systems intelligence, font pairings, layout guidelines, and Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics scorecard.
skills.executionEvidence: 1–5 usability scorecard across evaluated heuristics with verified observations.

skills.purpose: Visual hierarchy, typography scales, contrast ratios, and intentional non-generic styling.
skills.fallbackPolicy: Evaluate WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and CSS spacing rhythm directly.
skills.executionEvidence: Visual design findings citing contrast measurements and typographic scales.

skills.purpose: Design engineering polish: micro-interactions, transition physics, focus rings, optical alignment, and reduced motion.
triggerConditions: UI polish and component interaction tuning
skills.fallbackPolicy: Inspect CSS transitions, :focus-visible states, and prefers-reduced-motion media queries.
skills.executionEvidence: Documented motion duration, easing curves, and focus-visible ring implementations.

skills.purpose: Stress-testing UI components with worst-case data (extreme strings, emoji, empty states, zero items, huge counts).
triggerConditions: Edge-case testing for forms and tables
skills.fallbackPolicy: Pass synthetic extreme boundary values into component props or test runners.
skills.executionEvidence: Stress test results documenting overflow handling, truncation, and empty state rendering.
